ai_action_plan_2025.text: During our hearing with Director Kratsios, I advocated for stronger federal support for AI workforce development. I also took the opportunity to highlight the impressive work happening within our district to train the next generation of experts. My focus remains on reducing regulatory barriers to ensure American innovation continues to lead the way. This AI Action Plan reflects a coordinated, innovation-friendly approach providing the clarity our researchers and businesses need to maintain U.S. leadership in the global AI landscape.

deepseek.reason: The speaker praises the AI Action Plan as a coordinated, innovation-friendly approach that provides needed clarity.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly endorses the plan by describing it positively and linking it to U.S. leadership.

ai_action_plan_2025.text: A core pillar of the AI Action Plan is infrastructure, including our Nation's ability to develop a skilled workforce to use cutting-edge AI systems. North Carolina, as you know, has a growing ecosystem of higher education preparing the next generation of AI professionals. UNC (University of North Carolina)-Wilmington and Fayetteville State University in my district offer AI-focused education with hands-on experience. And community colleges, such as the Cape Fear Community College in my district, is advancing AI literacy and technical skills. Employer access, obviously, to these next-generation workers with these needed skills is critical for economic development and competitiveness.
ai_action_plan_2025.context: A lawmaker asks a question about federal collaboration with colleges and universities on AI workforce development during a hearing on the AI Action Plan.

deepseek.reason: The speaker describes workforce development as a core pillar of the AI Action Plan without endorsing or opposing the plan overall.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement names the plan but only describes one component, leaving no clear overall position.

ai_action_plan_2025.text: AI has the potential to revolutionize industries, all industries, really, but particularly of interest to me is agriculture and transportation, everything from precision farming and crop yield optimization to traffic management and autonomous vehicles.
ai_action_plan_2025.context: Remarks by Representative David Rouzer during a hearing on Advancing America's AI Action Plan.

deepseek.reason: The speaker discusses general benefits of AI in agriculture and transportation without addressing the AI Action Plan.
